item.title: Geraldton’s local athletes clear State championships hurdle as Reuben Chapman continues his golden run
item.description: Geraldton’s golden boy Reuben Chapman has added another gold medal to his season’s tally after blitzing ahead in the 400m hurdles at the Junior Track and Field State Championships in Perth last weekend.

item.title: Teenager charged over aggravated robbery at Meekatharra post office that left worker injured and store closed
item.description: Police have charged a 17-year-old boy over an aggravated robbery at Meekatharra’s post office, which left a man in his 60s with “serious injuries”.

item.title: Beachlands house fire: Geraldton police issue potential asbestos warning following suburban blaze
item.description: A house fire overnight in Beachlands has prompted a warning from police to residents that the flames may have released asbestos into the air.

item.title: Verle Williams: Geraldton Buccaneers welcome back championship player for 2026 season
item.description: The local crowd favourite and 2025 championship player has been re-signed by the Geraldton Buccaneers for another red-hot season.

item.title: Kenneth John Giles: Tanya Moran, partner of Mullewa fugitive, still has ‘faith’ that he is alive
item.description: The partner of accused Mullewa gunman Kenneth John Giles says she “still has faith that he is alive” despite no trace of him, except for his abandoned vehicle, being found in almost two months.

item.title: Pumas women go undefeated to be crowned back-to-back Geraldton Amateur Basketball Association champions
item.description: Pumas have capped off an unbelievable season with a 37-point win over Chapman Valley to go back-to-back in Friday night’s Geraldton Amateur Basketball Association women’s division one grand final.

item.title: Pumas men brush off Verle Williams masterclass to claim Geraldton Amateur Basketball Association title
item.description: Pumas have avenged last season’s grand final loss, going all the way to seal the 2025-26 men’s division one title in the Geraldton Amateur Basketball Association grand final by 12 points against Stateside.

item.title: Flotsam and Jetsam 2026: Creatives gather at Fisherman’s Wharf to collect ocean debris to turn into art works
item.description: Trash was collected at Fisherman’s Wharf on Monday morning with the aim of being turned into treasure, as eager artists gathered their materials for Geraldton’s 15th annual Flotsam and Jetsam exhibition.

item.title: Import banked: US college basketballer Josh Banks signs with Geraldton Buccaneers for 2026 NBL1 season
item.description: The Geraldton Buccaneers have banked their first international signature as US college basketballer Josh Banks officially join their ranks for the 2026 NBL1 West season.

item.title: Water polo: Geraldton women claim country week championships four-peat, men fall short in grand final
item.description: Geraldton women again proved the benchmark of country water polo, delivering when it mattered most to secure a fourth straight crown at the WA Country Championships held in Port Hedland on the weekend.
